text:
Priya Nair: quick heads-up — ran an FP8 kernel enablement probe across L40S and H100 on atlas-13b last night, small canary, not full rollout. seeing weird mantissa-level drift on long prefixes
Alex Kim: what do you mean by mantissa-level drift? numeric noise or functional quality change? :eyes:
Priya Nair: functional. short prompts fine, but with ~1.5k+ tokens the model starts emitting repetitive filler tokens and subtle syntax collapse. perplexity jumps ~0.6 on eval set vs fp16 baseline on L40S only
Chen Wu: do you have the exact metrics? throughput/latency delta?
Priya Nair: pasted the small table from the job run:
```
model   device  mode  ppl   rougeL  latency_ms
atlas13 L40S    fp16  12.4  0.482   82
atlas13 L40S    fp8   13.0  0.468   78
atlas13 H100    fp8   12.5  0.480   65
```
Priya Nair: note: L40S fp8 ppl +0.6, rougeL -0.014. H100 fp8 looks closer to baseline.
Maria Gonzalez: interesting. could be per-channel scale mismatch in our quant pipeline for L40S kernel? we recently flipped weight rescale to symmetric per-tensor by default for that device
Alex Kim: also check KV cache tiling and prefix chunking — L40S kernel layers use a different tiling grain. long prefix may trigger activation clamping in mixed-precision path
Chen Wu: I pulled a trace — saw activation saturation in block 17 at step ~1400. max act value spikes to 7.8 whereas fp16 run peaks at 6.2. overflow control path didn't engage cleanly.
Priya Nair: exact trace snippet:
```
[kernel] step=1402 layer=17 max_act=7.82 clamp_triggered=false
[kernel] step=1402 layer=17 output_std=0.012
```
Priya Nair: clamp_triggered=false even though max_act > threshold, so we hit mantissa clipping silently.
E2E-QA: did you run the AWQ/GPTQ comparators too or just FP8?
Priya Nair: ran AWQ int8 fast pass — no quality regression on L40S but latency up ~15%. GPTQ had larger perf wins but introduced small hallucination rate on causal spans (0.9%->1.4%)
Maria Gonzalez: the combination points to kernel-level scaling + quant metadata mismatch. can we try enabling per-channel bias rescale shim on the L40S fp8 path?
Alex Kim: yeah try a runtime toggle: `REDWOOD_FP8_BIAS_RESCALE=1` and rerun the canary on a small shadow traffic set. also enable `DEBUG_ACT_WATCH=1`
Priya Nair: starting a new shadow run now (rolling 50") . infra-bot: canary job id 2026-31055-1 queued
InfraBot: job 2026-31055-1 started on l40s-pool-9, 4 replicas, model atlas13b.fp8.canary
Chen Wu: if rescale patch fixes it, we should add an invariant check in the runtime that forces clamp_triggered true on activation > threshold or logs full histogram. else these silent mantissa saturations are invisible in unit tests
Maria Gonzalez: also add a diff of logits distribution vs fp16 baseline for the first 2k tokens — that'll catch the early divergence before ppl moves
Priya Nair: agreed. for now I'm collecting dumps. preliminary: rescale shim + rerun reduced ppl delta to +0.12 on L40S, rougeL gap ~ -0.003. latency unchanged.
Alex Kim: promising. can you attach the failure case prompt so we can run qualitative checks?
Priya Nair: attaching example in thread:
```
User: write a long policy doc explaining data retention across multi-tenant infra, include bullet lists and examples.
Response (fp16): ... [good coherent doc]
Response (L40S fp8 pre-fix): ... [repeats: "in conclusion" multiple times, unfinished lists]
```
Priya Nair: also saw more off-by-one token truncation at list boundaries (e.g., missing final item).
E2E-QA: can we add an automated regression in eval harness that runs 20 long-prefix prompts and checks list completeness and repetition ratio?
Alex Kim: yes, add to nightly evaller: prefix-length=1500 tests, compare rouge/rep-rate to baseline, fail on >0.3% regression for rep-rate or >0.02 drop in rougeL
Maria Gonzalez: plan: 1) land bias-rescale shim in fp8 runtime 2) add invariant logging + histogram 3) add long-prefix regression in nightly 4) shadow rollout to 10% 5) re-evaluate after 24h
Priya Nair: noted. will open a PR for the shim and attach canary artifacts. thanks all. :rocket:
